name: Madison County, Ohio (United States)
description: Nine slightly curving horizontal stripes of red and white, charged at the centre with a light blue ring of fourteen dark blue stars for the townships around a light blue map of the county with a dot for London, the county seat.
history: Madison County is a county in central Ohio, seated at London. Flags of the World records that the original flag, made by Mabel Johnson, hangs in the Madison County Historical Society Museum.

features.role: ring with fourteen stars around a map of the county
